KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Autumn Garden Tapestry

An abundant garden fills every inch here, its rounded trees shifting from deep green into orange, russet and gold and scattered with pink, white and yellow blooms; two small white rabbits rest near the centre and a terracotta pot anchors the lower edge. The style is intricate and storybook-charming, busy corner to corner with no single hotspot. Furniture can sit low anywhere, though centring a bed lets the rabbits peek above the headboard. A delightful pick for a kids' room, nursery or bedroom. Soft Matte stock suits the painterly density, and the design is composed as one continuous scene.
